title: Brownie-Mallow Bars
description: Indulge in this brownie-mallow bars recipe, layer decadent chocolatey brownies with gooey marshmallows and chocolate-peanut butter crispy rice cereal.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Combine brownie mix, oil, water, and eggs in a large bowl until smooth. Spread into the prepared baking dish.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, 28 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle marshmallows over brownie; continue baking until slightly melted, about 3 minutes. Set aside to cool completely.

Combine chocolate chips, peanut butter, and butter in a saucepan over low heat; cook and stir until smooth. Off heat, stir in rice cereal. Spread over brownies. Refrigerate until firm. Slice brownies to serve.

video.description: Boost your chocolate powers with this incredible layered brownie phenomenon. Atop your chocolaty brownie you’ll sprinkle marshmallows, toast them until they’re gooey, then douse everything with a thick frosting of peanut butter and chocolate. You’ll have plenty of new chocolate fans with this superbly fun and decadent brownie.
